name: Maintained-position qualifier
summary: A maintained-position qualifier indicates that the operating position remains after actuation.
description: A maintained-position qualifier indicates that the operating position remains after actuation. The mechanism retains the selected position after the operating action ends. The next manual action, release or other documented event changes that retained state.
This is especially useful when a maintained selector and a momentary command appear in the same control circuit. Draw their contact states and release relationships explicitly.
readingNotes: State the action required to release or change the maintained state.
Maintained operation differs from a timed hold and from automatic spring return.
